campaign_shifts.title: Shift 1: The Onboarding Watch
campaign_shifts.subtitle: Perimeter Reconnaissance & Baseline Discipline
campaign_shifts.briefing: Welcome to Sector 4 Triage, Analyst. Your objective on this shift is perimeter perimeter discipline. Filter out routine internal vulnerability scanning while blocking hostile reconnaissance sweeps and credential stuffing.

campaign_shifts.title: Shift 2: Phishing & Payload Infiltration
campaign_shifts.subtitle: Social Engineering & Living-off-the-Land Binaries
campaign_shifts.briefing: Adversaries are targeting employee inboxes with typosquatted portals. Distinguish authorized DevOps automation pushes from weaponized Office macros spawning hidden PowerShell reverse shells.

campaign_shifts.title: Shift 3: Covert Channels & Beaconing
campaign_shifts.subtitle: Time-Series Jitter Analysis & DNS Exfiltration
campaign_shifts.briefing: Adversaries have bypassed perimeter boundary rules. Use your newly unlocked Packet Capture Dissector and Threat Intel feed to identify covert DNS TXT exfiltration and periodic C2 heartbeat beacons.

campaign_shifts.title: Shift 4: The Insider & Supply Chain Breach
campaign_shifts.subtitle: UEBA Anomaly Detection & Signed Binary Backdoors
campaign_shifts.briefing: Threats are now originating from inside authorized perimeters. Distinguish legitimate off-hours database replication from rogue insider data egress, and inspect signed vendor binaries reading LSASS memory.

campaign_shifts.title: Shift 5: Zero Hour — Ransomware Outbreak
campaign_shifts.subtitle: SMB Lateral Spread & Volume Shadow Copy Destruction
campaign_shifts.briefing: EMERGENCY OUTBREAK: Active enterprise ransomware deployment targeting departmental file shares. Stop SMB lateral movement across port 445, protect disaster recovery systems, and contain infected endpoints before disk encryption completes.
